summary: Both registered candidates declined with frozen evidence. Candidate A (blind aliases) passed every safety guard - public transcript byte-identical, all noninferiority axes clean - but recovered 1 of 13 baseline turn-1 misses and 0 of 6 ever-misses on the dev category axis, against a primary gate of +0.030 turn-1 pool recall with a positive lower bound. Candidate B (catalog-only sparse MNN) was disqualified at the V6-D8 outcome-blind audit before any score run: 32.9% supported precision against a 98% bar; the map is dominated by catalog-text exhaust (SKU fragments, bare measurements, marketing coincidences), not shopper shelf vocabulary.
what_the_cycle_established: The dev category-axis loss is real shelf-resolution loss: all 6 ever-misses are wrong/missing shelf resolution, 5/6 with the head token implicated (analysis/v6_miss_taxonomy.json).

General-language aliases over canonical shelf heads fire often (36/100 sessions) but almost never on the vocabulary the harness actually substitutes: the transform had no alias match on 6 of 13 turn-1 misses and added non-target shelves on the rest but one.

Catalog-only mutual nearest neighbours at the registered formula do not produce shopper-vocabulary mappings: the co-occurrence signal at 0.80 cosine is dominated by listing noise (audit: 145/441 supported).

The exact-route parity machinery works: the candidate's public transcript and score are byte-identical to baseline (7c30023e..., 0.916125) with zero transform lookups on exact sessions, and every prefix digest matched (V6-D1/V6-D2).
The addendum's A1 prediction did not hold on dev: misses split buying 3 / browsing 2 / intent_override 1, not override-concentrated.
sealed_sets: S1/S2 never consumed; ledger empty (analysis/v6_validation_ledger.json). They remain sealed and may not be repurposed for a retuned variant.
serving: default remains P_SHELF_TRANSFORM=off; the dormant hook, shared contract, and both frozen assets are retained as build-only evidence so the negative is exactly reproducible
closed_routes: shelf aliases and catalog-only sparse MNN for non-exact shelf resolution are closed and enter the declined ledger; no retuning, no ensemble, no third candidate
suite: 467 + candidate tests green at the decline commit
